en: Changed workflow scripts' computed `agent()` prompts on Bedrock, Vertex and Foundry to reach the subagent framed as script-authored text, so the safety classifier does not read them as the user
zh: 变更：在 Bedrock、Vertex 和 Foundry 上，工作流脚本计算出的 `agent()` prompt 以脚本撰写文本的形式送达 subagent，使安全分类器不会将其误读为用户输入
